memberships.page_title: Finite Triple Covers, Conductors, and Automorphisms

statement: For the normalized cubic discriminant, with H=3A(c)t+B(c), the conductor in C[c,t] is H^2 and the conductor ideal in the discriminant ring is generated by B^2-3Ab and 18Aa+Bb; transversely the singularity is the ordinary cusp C[H^2,H^3] inside C[H].
